changelog: Say "insert Anna after Emily" — or "কামাল এর পরে আনা লিখো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and that word is inserted after Emily wherever it sits in the message; "insert Anna before Emily" and "insert Anna at the end" work the same way. Gboard's Pixel 8+ "Insert [word] before/after [word]" command, now on this keyboard in English and Bengali — the fix for a word left out mid-message.
